sample_note: Abbreviated sample of a clean run with one INFO note (based on clean config C04). Use it to build the 'no problems' screen.

rules.text: Investors registered in a restricted country (408) may not receive tokens.

properties.name: invariant_noRestrictedCountryReceiverOnTransfer
properties.description: After any successful transfer, the receiver is not in country 408.

properties.name: invariant_noRestrictedCountryReceiverOnMint

findings.title: Agent forcedTransfer can reach a restricted country (known exception)
findings.policy_violated: Investors registered in a restricted country (408) may not receive tokens.
findings.explanation: A token agent can use forcedTransfer to move tokens to a wallet in a restricted country. This is by design in T-REX (court orders, recovery), and the country module does not check it. It is listed for your information, not as a bypass.
findings.suggested_fix: No fix needed if agent exceptions are accepted. If not, restrict who holds the agent role.
